record.paper_title: Hamiltonian formulation of General Relativity 50 years after the Dirac celebrated paper: do unsolved problems still exist?
record.context_brief: Extending simple-model results to full gravity
record.original_question: Can the results of the extended phase-space approach, which have been demonstrated only for simple models with finitely many degrees of freedom, be reproduced for the full gravitational theory?

evidence.quote: Our purpose is to review the above questions and to demonstrate advantages of the extended phase space approach by the example of a simple model with finite number degrees of freedom.
Of course, until now our results have been demonstrated for simple models and it would be important to reproduce them for the full gravitational theory.

artifact.status_search_result: Recent works (2025–2026) by Shestakova continue to develop and discuss the extended phase space approach, presenting features and perspectives of the program but still working in the setting of symmetry-reduced models (e.g., spherically symmetric systems, minisuperspace) rather than full General Relativity. No source found establishes the program for the full gravitational theory; the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: The extended phase space approach to quantization of gravity and its perspective
status_evidence.snippet: The extended phase space approach... alternative to Wheeler-DeWitt; discussion of perspectives.
status_evidence.claim: As of 2026 the approach is still being developed and surveyed, indicating the full-gravity extension is not completed.

status_evidence.title: Some features of the extended phase space approach to quantization of gravity
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses features of the extended phase space approach, working with reduced/symmetric systems.
status_evidence.claim: Recent paper still treats features within reduced models, not the full gravitational theory.

status_evidence.title: The Schrödinger Equation for a Spherically Symmetric System, Its Structure and Solutions
status_evidence.snippet: Schrödinger equation derived for a spherically symmetric system in the extended phase space approach.
status_evidence.claim: Demonstrations remain confined to symmetry-reduced models with finitely many degrees of freedom.
